steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: Here, eat this to replenish your energy. No biscuit for you. That's what you get for running off like a little kiddo.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: But we saved a piece of candy for you. A brave child who protects companions deserves a reward.
You take the stone-hard bread and broken hard candy. You're not hungry and don't have to eat, but one still has to talk tough.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: Okay okay, go over there and take care of Dreya and the wounded. Or get some sleep. We'll be on the move again soon. Little kids should keep their strength up.

This is the eighth futile rebuttal you've made. To these "people," you're not an adult at all, no matter how tall you are. Or rather, anything you do that exceeds what a "child" does is ignored. It's as if you're acting out a scripted movie.
You've tried to secretly cast your shackles, but they just pass through them. These "teammates" and "Dreya" are all holograms.
The only person the shackles ever touched is now discussing something with her teammates, an unprecedentedly serious look on her face.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: They evolve too quickly. Brute force won't work. We need to change our approach to get our remaining companions back... If we consider the Mutant Bugs as a type of Apostle of Ashes and analyze their habits, we might find a breakthrough.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: But all the Apostles of Ashes are heading for the Perishing Star. You said that this behavior is the core feature of the Apostles. The Mantises only stay on the outskirts of the forbidden zone, and even occasionally leave DisSea to prey on humans. They're different.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...Only what's manifested is different.
You eavesdrop from under the car and get a rough understanding of the situation:

The sudden Illusory Moon anomaly disrupted the expedition's plans. A four-person team including the astronomer went missing, and an investigation revealed that they were forced to flee into Mutant Bug territory.

As a naturalist studying Mantises, "Mantis" led a rescue team deep into the hinterland to find her teammates. A few days passed, and they found three people but lost two more. Including the "guide" who popped up, the six people here now are all that's left.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: In their natural state, the Apostles of Ashes have no stable form. Their energy and radiation changes unpredictably, and their collapse or re-emergence cannot be logically explained. People attribute this to the unique power of the Apostles of Ashes and fear it.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: But no one really knows for sure. This phenomenon could still have other explanations.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Before joining the expedition, I led a team to track and observe the Apostles of Ashes. Rather than saying their forms are unpredictable, it's more accurate to say that their material existence in this world is extremely unstable. It's as if they have some <color=#fb9259>serious flaw</color>.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Apostles of Ashes worldwide do share a common feature: they migrate to the Perishing Star without stopping. They don't do it to feed, reproduce, or evolve, but I have a guess...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Perhaps these apocalyptic creatures are seeking the Perishing Star to <color=#fb9259>fix</color> their own flaw. The Perishing Star, or something in this forbidden zone, allows them to exist more stably in our material world.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: ...You've discussed this many times. Without knowing what the Perishing Star is, this hypothesis is hard to verify and doesn't help the expedition.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Yes, we can't reach the Perishing Star. But the Mantises provide another research direction... a simple <color=#fb9259>extrapolation</color>.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: They are a relatively weak Apostle, afraid to go deeper into the forbidden zone and face stronger "mutants." Thus, they only hover around the outskirts of DisSea in swarms. But they also need to fix themselves, so they constantly kidnap humans nearby... I guess humans are a <color=#fb9259>substitute</color> for the Perishing Star.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: From when they were first recorded till now, the Mantises' form has grown visibly more stable. Their behavioral intelligence has improved, and their perception towards humans has deepened. Their flaw is being remedied by "hunting" humans and human belongings.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: They're curious about humans. They try to understand humans and even imitate humans. I can occasionally scare them off with a mirror. The perception they have of themselves and humans may have shifted, or merged.
She whispers, her voice gradually lowering, but her speech quickens, and her emotions become increasingly fervent.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Perhaps this is the <color=#fb9259>essence</color> of the Apostle of Ashes. The so-called "creature" is a manifestation of a certain collective human consciousness invading reality. The Mantis has a strong swarm attribute, so it could be a manifestation of the human concept of collectivity.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: The instability of the collective subconscious leads to the instability of the Apostle. Strengthening their own collective consciousness is their way of stabilizing themselves. This can be proven over time, but more importantly...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: If they really are manifestations of human consciousness, then we might be able to understand these terrifying creatures, and even communicate with them. If their origin is also "human," we might be able to awaken their <color=#fb9259>humanity</color> and...

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: Communicate with them? Do you have a death wish?! This isn't one of your television shows! You think your naive and baseless guesses can keep us all alive?!

A sharp rebuke interrupts the scholar's fervent analysis. "Mantis" snaps her head up as if waking up with a start. She meets the iron-faced gaze of her companion and comes to her senses, the color gradually draining from her face.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: ...I understand how you feel. If the monsters could be understood, humanity could avoid many deaths. It's a beautiful wish, but...

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: It's too difficult. These monsters have claimed countless lives worldwide. Your guesses, on the other hand, lack evidence and persuasion. Humanity doesn't have the resources to prove it... Pure hope and desire is not enough.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...No, I should be the one apologizing. I really have no way to prove it. The apocalypse isn't a TV show... acting on assumptions will only lead us all into danger.

A sense of guilt lingers in the silence following the outburst. Seeing Mantis hang her head, the woman's face shifts from anger to remorse. She grasps the scholar's hand, but can only muster a painfully sorrowful smile.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: Your positivity has always encouraged us, but in the end, it's your rationality as scholars that saves lives and brings salvation to humanity.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: Let's go back to base. This rescue mission's goal is to find you scholars and ensure your safety. The Mutant Bugs will be back. We can't stay here for long.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...Now? Some people haven't returned yet. Your husband was taken away by a Mantis. If we leave now, he will...

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: If we leave now, at least you, Dreya and the guide will survive. The expedition team can't lose you. After taking you back, I'll come back to rescue the others.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team Member
steps.content: My husband... he would make the same choice. He would also do everything to protect humanity's top scholars and safeguard the hope to defeat the apocalypse.
"Mantis" opens her mouth but says nothing. A look at her companion's expression tells her there's no room for negotiation. She lowers her head.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: <size=28>...I'm not that strong... if it weren't for all of you...</size>
The team member seems to want to say something else. "Mantis" lifts her head again, forcing a somewhat strained smile.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: It's nothing! I'm going to prepare some weapons that can repel bugs. They always come in handy.
A few minutes later, the scholar is silently assembling ammunition with her back to you. You're hiding under the vehicle, undecided on what to do. She starts to speak.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Come out, kid. I know you've been eavesdropping.

You crawl out from under the vehicle and silently stand by the scholar, helping her with the ammo. She turns to smile at you. You can't shake the feeling that her smile is somewhat forced, which makes you sad.

options: Everyone's just looking out for you.

steps.content: As soon as the words leave your mouth, you realize how feeble your attempt to comfort her is. In this illusion, how much help can a "child's" comfort be to a scholar facing the immense pressure of life and death?
Seeing you stop mid-sentence, Mantis doesn't press for more. After a while, she softly continues.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Before joining the expedition team, I filmed four seasons of the blockbuster documentary series, "Wilderness Trek," which became a worldwide hit. When people talk about me, they praise me as a heroic survival expert and a trustworthy naturalist.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: To be a heroic survival expert, one must be romantic and brave, ready to face disaster and unveil the truth. One must never give up, and bring courage and confidence to everyone in the Nightfall era.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: On the other hand, to be a trusted naturalist, one must be prudent and cautious. One must collect data bit by bit, then analyze and summarize it. One must boldly hypothesize and carefully verify the results, and face countless disappointing failures without cheating or lying.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Which identity do you think suits me better, kid?

options: Survival expert. You gave me courage.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Hehe, thank you. Actually, I'm good at both, like a superhero. Pretty cool, right?
She smiles brightly again. Then, the smile fades into an expression that you cannot tell is gentle or forlorn.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Because I am not alone...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Back then, I had an entire filming crew with me, traveling north and south, traversing the apocalypse. We were chased by all kinds of monsters. Together, we celebrated our victories and shouldered each other's failures. We overcame difficulties with one another, and collectively dreamed of a brighter future.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Grouping up is truly humanity's most wonderful attribute. Even though I'm just an ordinary person, with them, I can keep going no matter how dark the night. With them, I am invincible.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: So, for me, my most important identity is clear... "everyone's companion."

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Just like now, some people comforted me, some shook me back to my senses, and some made me worry... I won't be lost. With you guys, I'm a superhero.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: This superhero will definitely take you all back. No companion left behind.
Her contagious laughter is devoid of any gloom.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I haven't watched "Wilderness Trek" yet. Will you show me when we get back to the camp? After the expedition is over, I'll apply to join the filming crew, too. It looks fun.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...Haha, now that you mention it, I never thought about filming a fifth season.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: There will be many delicious bugs to eat once we're out. Don't be a picky eater, okay?
She ruffles your hair, and is about to say something else when a scream suddenly interrupts. You both rush over immediately.

The female team member who just comforted Mantis is now staring pale-faced at the entrance of the hideout. A man covered in filth is robotically and manically destroying the surrounding bug repellent devices.

"Mantis" also freezes, then quickly steps forward to shield you. She raises her gun and shoots decisively at the man's leg. The monster falls to his knees with a muffled thud, but "Mantis's" teammate lets out a cry.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Back off! I only incapacitated him, but he's not your husband anymore! Protect yourself!

The man on the ground is making chaotic noises, and starts to bite with his mouth. His face is shriveled, as if he's been drained dry, and there's no sign of humanity in his eyes. Yet this appearance is vaguely familiar to you.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Watch out!!

The last device is paralyzed, and two giant scythes break out of the man's body. A black, evil arthropod creature is born from the bloody rain. The scene is too overwhelming. As everyone is frozen in place by shock, the incoming swarm of Mutant Bugs snatches them away.
As the monster charges at you, a gunshot rings out, and several Mutant Bug heads are blown apart. You turn to see "Mantis" holding a gun, shielding you behind her.
Her sunny disposition had disappeared, replaced by a terrifying power that is suppressed but stirring in the darkness.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...Kid, take care of the injured. Don't leave them. It's all up to you here...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I'm going to bring our companions back.
Green flames flash in the scholar's eyes. She rushes out so fast that you have no time to react. You couldn't stop her at all.

Scarface vomited over the rail, then crushed a writhing creature that had crawled aboard and hurled it back into the sea. A trail of foul slime sprayed across the deck, releasing a putrid, fishy stench.
The moment she rushed out, you saw black spikes growing out of her body.
You must find her and get her to come back. You have a bad feeling about this.
